concepts.label: A — Le piège télévisé
concepts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished high-quality 16:9 YouTube thumbnail illustration, landscape 1920x1080 composition, for "L Outsmarts Light Analysed like Chess | Death Note". New concept: the broadcast trap. Authentic late-2000s Death Note anime cel aesthetic: precise confident ink lines, flat controlled cel shading, highly recognizable canon character shapes, not photorealistic, not a glossy painterly AI poster. Light Yagami's enormous face dominates the RIGHT half: canonical brown fringe, narrow brown anime eyes, genuinely shocked tense expression, one small sweat bead, mouth slightly open. Show his cropped notebook hand near lower right, not floating fingers. LEFT: a smaller but clearly recognizable L Lawliet, black untidy spiky hair, pale face, unmistakable dark under-eye shadows, calm intelligent expression, index finger near mouth. In front of L, ONE old CRT television seen nearly straight on, dark screen with a single simple white capital "L"; imply the televised trap, do not put L's real face on the screen. Mood: psychological ambush, deep charcoal and muted olive-yellow highlights, restrained red rim on Light, no blue/red split background, no diagonal white divider. Clear hierarchy: Light face first, television second, L third; three strong shapes, uncluttered. Large exact headline along lower left: "IT WAS A TRAP" in very bold condensed white capitals with black outline, no other words. The letters must be crisp, huge, readable at phone scale, never over faces or notebook. Reserve clean dark circular badge zones 150px in the upper-left and upper-right corners, well away from all eyes and hair detail: final authentic chess rating SVGs will be added later. Do NOT draw circles, punctuation badges, chess logos or watermarks. Faces occupy central heights, make their eyes below the reserved top-corner zones. Edge-to-edge art, no border, no additional characters, no false episode screenshot label. This is a designed illustration of the episode's trap, not a copied frame.

concepts.label: B — Le duel, style anime
concepts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE polished 16:9 landscape YouTube thumbnail, for "L Outsmarts Light Analysed like Chess | Death Note". A radically tighter authentic Death Note anime showdown, not an illustrated promotional poster: clean sharp TV-anime cel drawing with angular faces, restrained two-tone shadow shapes, exact recognizable canonical hairstyles and proportions. L Lawliet on LEFT and Light Yagami on RIGHT in enormous side-by-side three-quarter head closeups, both facing inward. The eyes and expressions are the entire hook. L: pale skin, untidy black pointed hair, heavy under-eye shadows, large dark anime eyes with a quiet almost invisible knowing smile, no beard. Light: warm light skin, canonical brown straight swept fringe, narrow brown eyes looking at L, clenched jaw and visible panic behind anger, no cartoon scream. Crop at cheek/neck level, both faces together occupy 85 percent of the frame and their eyes sit around 48 percent image height, comfortably visible. Dynamic off-center meeting line slightly right of center, no thick white diagonal divider; one narrow bright sliver between the two profiles gives a cinematic confrontation. Background extremely simple charcoal with small pale cream space behind L and deep blood-red space behind Light, no grunge, no swirling effects, no textures, no glowing aura, no 3D. Use authentic neutral skin color rather than coloring the whole faces blue/red. Powerful expressive drawn eyes, hard crisp contrast; make this look like an exceptional still from the original anime drawn for a thumbnail. NO TEXT at all, no fake quotes. Reserve clean dark 150px badge zones at both upper corners above the expressions for later authentic rating SVG overlays. Do NOT generate any chess icons, punctuation circles, logos or watermarks. Do not imitate the old generic equal split glossy fanart design.

concepts.label: C — Manga sur fond blanc
concepts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE 16:9 high-end graphic manga YouTube thumbnail for "L Outsmarts Light Analysed like Chess | Death Note". New visual style: bold black-and-white manga cutouts on an almost white background, designed like a crisp arresting graphic cover, with two character faces and ONE red accent, very legible at small size. L Lawliet on LEFT, about 52 percent frame width, three-quarter bust in canonical loose white long-sleeve shirt; unmistakable messy black hair, pale face, huge dark eyes and dark eye bags, relaxed cunning gaze aimed at the viewer, finger at his lips. Light Yagami on RIGHT, about 44 percent width, authentic neat brown fringe rendered black/gray, white shirt collar, head turned slightly toward L, startled realization, one sharp sweat mark and tight mouth. Strict Death Note manga character drawing, confident line art, broad solid black shadows, sharp hatching only in limited hair areas; no soft airbrush, no realism, no kawaii. White background and black ink make faces stand out, with one very thick short red directional line between them implying the trap has reversed. It must not cross eyes or cover faces. Cropped shoulders lower edge. NO lettering, NO speech bubbles, NO chess pieces, NO third person, NO ornamental composition. Keep upper-left and upper-right corner 150px badge zones almost white and quiet, outside hair and faces; actual Chess.com SVG rating badges are added later. Do NOT generate rating symbols or circles. Large clear face silhouettes, breathing room, strong sparse poster design. L face eye level 47 percent height, Light eye level 48 percent. Distinct from blue-red split screenshots and generic textured fanart.

concepts.label: D — L contrôle la partie
concepts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE premium 16:9 landscape anime YouTube thumbnail for "L Outsmarts Light Analysed like Chess | Death Note". New composition: original visual chess metaphor for the televised trap, not a literal scene screenshot, no floating human heads on pawns. L Lawliet dominates LEFT and CENTER in an enormous three-quarter closeup, pale skin, canonical spiky untidy black hair, large dark eyes with unmistakable shadows underneath, calm knowing look, white long sleeve. His single visible hand carefully holds ONE simple WHITE pawn in the lower center foreground. Pawns have the classic round ball head, neck, collar and round base, not kings or knights, realistic simple ivory material. At lower-right, ONE fallen BLACK pawn lies on a dark clean surface with only a few subtle chessboard squares. Light Yagami appears in RIGHT background as a smaller but still large recognizable cropped face, canonical straight brown fringe, narrow brown eyes and furious shocked realization, hand-free. Exact anime character designs, refined original cel-shaded illustration, crisp flat shadow shapes and strong silhouette readability, not photorealistic, not painterly, not glossy CGI. The thumbnail says strategic reversal through one held white pawn and one toppled black pawn; do not show a complex full board, no fake checkmate position or chess notation. Mostly neutral black, ivory and deep muted burgundy; warm highlight catches the white pawn and L's eyes. Dark nearly empty background, no magic aura, no particles. Text exact: "ONE MISTAKE" in giant restrained off-white bold condensed capitals along bottom-left, leave the pawn fully visible and keep type off faces. Reserve clean 150px badge zones in upper left and upper right away from facial details for real SVG rating badges added later. Do NOT draw chess rating circles, punctuation badges, logos or watermarks. The scene is a conceptual artwork, make expressions believable rather than silly.
